title: Mushroom Kick Ceramic Coffee Mug - 15oz
body:
Introducing our sleek and stylish Mushroom Kick Ceramic Coffee Mug, perfect for your daily mushroom coffee or tea rituals. This glossy ceramic mug offers a sophisticated vibe, making every sip a visual delight. Whether you're cozying up at home, working at the office, or celebrating with friends, this mug adds a touch of elegance to every occasion.

Product features
- Glossy ceramic finish for a sleek look
- Microwave-safe for convenience
- Dishwasher-safe for easy cleaning
- Lead and BPA-free, ensuring safety

Care instructions
- Clean in dishwasher (put the product on top rack), or wash by hand with warm water and dish soap
